projects.name: Automated Subscriptions
projects.tagline: Automatic billing for ERPNext Subscriptions, with payment requests, billing anchors, proration, consolidated invoices, and credit notes.

projects.name: Avunu Odoo Addons
projects.tagline: Avunu's Odoo 18 Community modules for email and SMS, document import, AI providers, and the backend and shop-floor UI, built to work alongside OCA.

projects.name: Carbon Theme
projects.tagline: A complete IBM Carbon Design System theme for Frappe and ERPNext, covering the desk, website, login, email, charts, and tables.

projects.name: Cloudflare Email
projects.tagline: Email for Frappe, ERPNext, Odoo and WordPress without SMTP or IMAP: sent through the Cloudflare API, received through a relay that stores every message before it delivers it.

projects.name: Cloudflare Email Delivery
projects.tagline: Send and receive Frappe and ERPNext email through Cloudflare, with no SMTP or IMAP provider in the loop.

projects.name: Data Steward
projects.tagline: Audited data corrections for Frappe and ERPNext admins, including bulk merge, item-to-variant conversion, and bank clearance fixes, each gated behind a setting.

projects.name: Employee Timeclock
projects.tagline: Badge-scan timeclock kiosks for ERPNext and HRMS, with a daily punch record per employee and job-card time tracking for the shop floor.

projects.name: ERPNext CIS Plus
projects.tagline: Simpler customer, contact, and address management for ERPNext, with address validation, geolocation, and a map of your customers.

projects.name: ERPNext TaskView
projects.tagline: A project and task workspace for ERPNext, with timers and hour budgets for staff and a portal where customers follow and work on their projects.

projects.name: eSign Web Forms
projects.tagline: Collect electronic signatures on any Frappe or ERPNext document through web forms, with signed PDFs and a full audit trail.

projects.name: frappe-nix
projects.tagline: Reproducible Nix infrastructure for Frappe and ERPNext, from the development shell to OCI containers and a multi-site NixOS module.

projects.name: JWT Bearer Auth
projects.tagline: Single sign-on for Frappe and ERPNext from an identity provider's JWT, such as Cloudflare Access, with automatic login and optional user registration.

projects.name: Mercury Banking Integration
projects.tagline: Connects ERPNext to Mercury bank for client billing, payroll and vendor ACH, bank sync, reconciliation, and GL-coded journal entries.

projects.name: Messaging
projects.tagline: A unified chat-style inbox for email and SMS in Frappe and ERPNext, with Twilio texting, group broadcasts, and mail-merge newsletters.

projects.name: NixOS Micro Desktop
projects.tagline: A low-maintenance NixOS desktop inspired by openSUSE Aeon, set up once and then managed through GNOME Software and Flatpak.

projects.name: nixos-rclone
projects.tagline: A NixOS module and Rust daemon for rclone mounts and two-way sync that pushes local changes in seconds, with Markdown-to-docx conversion built in.

projects.name: odoo-nix
projects.tagline: Reproducible Nix infrastructure for Odoo Community (OCB) and OCA projects, from scaffolding and development to containers and NixOS.

projects.name: PostGrid Direct Mail
projects.tagline: Mail printed Frappe and ERPNext documents as physical letters through PostGrid, by hand or automatically from Notifications.

projects.name: python-devops-nix
projects.tagline: The shared Nix base for frappe-nix and odoo-nix: secrets, backups, devguard, Python environments, development-shell pieces, NixOS production pieces and the conventions both products follow.

projects.name: site-docs
projects.tagline: The source of docs.avunu.net: the build that turns the docs/ folder of every Avunu project into one site.

projects.name: UI Text Editor
projects.tagline: Replaces the Quill editor behind every Text Editor field in the Frappe desk with the frappe-ui editor, keeping saved values compatible.

projects.name: Web Kiosk
projects.tagline: A USB-booting NixOS image that turns an x86 computer into a locked-down Firefox kiosk for a single web page.

projects.name: WordPress Cloudflare Email
projects.tagline: Routes all WordPress email through the Cloudflare Email Sending API and keeps a searchable log of every message, with no settings screen.

projects.name: WordPress JWT Auth
projects.tagline: Replaces WordPress logins with single sign-on through an OIDC provider or an identity-aware proxy, configured entirely in wp-config.php.

projects.name: wordpress-nix
projects.tagline: A fast FrankenPHP WordPress stack built with Nix, deployable as OCI containers or a NixOS module, with MySQL or Turso databases.

projects.name: WP Cloud Files
projects.tagline: Stores and serves the WordPress media library from S3-compatible object storage, with direct browser uploads and document thumbnails.
